blockers: Class NOT_VASP_OWNED has 0 labelled address(es); 20 are required (ML_MIN_SAMPLES_PER_CLASS). Training is refused rather than reporting a metric estimated from too few samples to mean anything.
Class VASP_OWNED has 1 labelled address(es); 20 are required (ML_MIN_SAMPLES_PER_CLASS). Training is refused rather than reporting a metric estimated from too few samples to mean anything.

The negative class is empty by design. 7673 address(es) in this investigation carry no dataset entry, but absence from a curated seed set is not evidence that an address is not VASP-controlled, so none of them may be labelled NOT_VASP_OWNED. Filling this class requires negatives with a documented reason — for example addresses independently attested as self-custody, or contracts whose code proves they are not a custodial deposit account.
notes: 5 dataset address(es) were excluded from labels because their provenance is a third-party or community label. Such an entry is good enough to report as attribution evidence with its source attached, but training on it would teach the model to reproduce an annotator rather than a fact.

split_report.strategy: Group-disjoint three-way split on group_key (operator name where known, otherwise the address), then StratifiedGroupKFold cross-validation on train+validation for model selection. The test split is read exactly once, after the winner is refit.

training.class_imbalance_handling: class_weight='balanced' where the estimator supports it, and balanced per-sample weights at fit time for the boosting models that do not. The decision threshold was chosen on the validation split by maximising F1.

Their features are therefore not statistically independent, which inflates held-out scores relative to a separately-crawled sample. Group-aware splitting cannot remove this; only a second, independent crawl would.
